newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cricket-West Indies slump to 169 for seven v Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-West Indies slump to 169 for seven v Pakistan.

text.p: West Indies lost another two wickets, including that of stand-in captain Carl Hooper, to collapse to 169 for seven in their World Series limited overs match on Tuesday.
Hooper, leading the side in the absence of Courtney Walsh, made just one run before he was caught by Aamir Sohail off pace bowler Waqar Younis.
His dismissal followed that of Robert Samuels, leg before wicket to Waqar for three.
Off-spinner Saqlain Mushtaq earlier captured two wickets in quick succession as West Indies slumped from 156 for three to 160 for five. Saqlain has three for 13 from six overs.
Jimmy Adams was seven not out and Ian Bishop yet to score.
Both teams have already qualified for the series finals starting in Sydney on Saturday, prompting West Indies to rest Walsh and star batsman Brian Lara.
